description:
Implement the Builder design pattern for the Employee class in the 'hr-core' Maven project.

The project is located at ~/eclipse-workspace/hr-core. The 'Employee' class in 'src/main/java/com/acme/hr/model/Employee.java' currently has 12 private fields but no constructor or setters.

Your task:
1. Open the 'Employee' class in Eclipse.
2. Create a public static inner class named 'Builder' inside the Employee class.
3. Implement fluent setter methods in the Builder for all 12 fields (e.g., 'public Builder firstName(String val)').
4. Implement a 'build()' method in the Builder that returns a new 'Employee' instance populated with the set values.
5. Create a new JUnit 5 test class 'src/test/java/com/acme/hr/model/EmployeeBuilderTest.java'.
6. Write a test method that constructs an Employee using the Builder, setting at least 6 different fields, and asserts that the created Employee object has the correct values.
7. Run the test in Eclipse to ensure it passes.

Note: The project is already configured with JUnit 5 dependencies.
